description: This file defines the Expression interface used within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.placeholders package. It specifies methods related to parsing and handling expressions that involve a prefix and a name separated by a colon.

classes.name: Expression
classes.description: An interface representing an expression with a prefix and a name, separated by a constant separator.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix part of the expression.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Retrieves the list of names that this expression can substitute.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a given name is supported by the expression.
